title: Dutch Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful dish made with tender stew meat, served with a side of pickled vegetables.
instructions: Season the stew meat with knockout black pepper.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the stew meat until browned on all sides.
Remove the stew meat from the pot and set aside.
Add the pungent onion to the pot and sauté until softened.
Add the pickle juice to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the stew meat to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1-2 hours.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with pickle slices.
